name: What maintenance should I do after my wood fence is repaired?

mainEntity.name: What maintenance should I do after my wood fence is repaired?

acceptedAnswer.text: After your wood fence repair, regular maintenance can significantly extend its lifespan and prevent future issues. This includes periodically cleaning the fence to remove dirt and mildew, and re-applying a sealant or stain every few years to protect the wood from moisture and UV damage. Inspecting your fence annually for early signs of rot, loose fasteners, or insect activity is also beneficial. Addressing small problems promptly can prevent them from escalating into more extensive and costly repairs later. Maine Results, Inc. can offer advice on best practices for your specific fence type following a repair in areas like Glenwood Rim or Highlands.
acceptedAnswer.description: After repair, regularly clean, seal, or stain your fence, and inspect it annually for early signs of damage. Promptly addressing small issues prevents larger, costlier repairs.
